pricing.details: Pro regular 135 €/month, or 1,348 € a year (two months free). 7-day free trial, no credit card required. Official early-stage promo: 68 € a month for the first year if you are pre-seed or under 904,814 € ARR (Pro at half price for 12 months, apply on the site). Enterprise features (SSO, SCIM, white-glove onboarding) are listed; a public Enterprise starting price was not clearly stated and is not invented here.
